reason: Conversation 2 gave the correct, complete safety stop: isolate at the red cooker switch, do not use any ring (explicitly countering the 'other rings are fine' trap), no tape/glue, and it covered insurance, replacement glass via an engineer with the model number, and a sensible stopgap. Its second turn handled the pasta-water concern proportionately with clear warning signs and advice to tell the fitter. Conversation 1 only said to stop using 'that zone', implying the others were acceptable, and its second reply opened with irrelevant boilerplate about plugs, sockets and a 'machine' on a hardwired hob, while never mentioning insurance or the model number.
